label: Captain Holt's first greeting — the border observation

purpose.value: Holt gives the hero a professional's free advice: he has reviewed every engagement on the Witness Glass, and every battle begins only after the hero crosses someone else's border — every single one.

emotionalProgression.note: Brave, fit, disciplined: Holt grades him like a recruit and finds one fact that matters missing.
Verdict first, evidence second: who crossed the border armed? You did. Second question: see question one.
The hero hears a veteran's grudging respect for his campaign and salutes; Holt drops the 'son'.

notes: Misunderstanding pair (Lore.md): 'You are causing all of this' → 'Survivor's guilt. A tragic consequence of witnessing true evil.' Holt KNOWS the book is a children's comedy and can say so in parade-ground terms; the hero files it as enemy disinformation. He knows the Heavy Hands / gate-seal chain, but that indictment is reserved for late runs — here it is the border fact only. Never validate the hero's prophecy framing: there is no canon fact supporting 'the realms are evil', and that absence is itself the guard.
